district.name: Vijayanagara
district.description: Karnataka's 31st district, home to the world-renowned UNESCO World Heritage site of Hampi, the grand Tungabhadra Dam, Virupaksha temple, stone chariot, and majestic boulder-strewn landscapes.
district.descriptionKannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ೩೧ನೇ ಜಿಲ್ಲೆ, ಜಗತ್ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ ಯುನೆಸ್ಕೋ ವಿಶ್ವ ಪರಂಪರೆ ತಾಣ ಹಂಪಿ, ತುಂಗಭದ್ರಾ ಜಲಾಶಯ, ವಿರೂಪಾಕ್ಷ ದೇವಾಲಯ, ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ರಥ ಮತ್ತು ಭವ್ಯ ಬಂಡೆಗಲ್ಲುಗಳ ಭೂದೃಶ್ಯಗಳ ತವರು.

destinations.name: Hampi UNESCO World Heritage Complex
destinations.description: The monumental capital of the 14th-century Vijayanagara Empire covering 4,187 hectares across boulder-strewn hills and Tungabhadra riverbanks, featuring the iconic Vijaya Vittala Stone Chariot, musical pillars, Virupaksha Temple, and Lotus Mahal.
destinations.historicalSignificance: UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1986. Chronicled by medieval travellers Abdur Razzak, Domingo Paes, and Fernao Nuniz as one of the richest cities in the world.
destinations.culturalImportance: Sacred Pampa Kshetra and living temple tradition at Virupaksha, alongside grand annual Hampi Utsava celebrated with classical music and lights.

photos.caption: Hampi UNESCO World Heritage Complex
photos.source: Archaeological Survey of India & UNESCO World Heritage Centre

destinations.bestSeason: October to March (Hampi Utsava in November/January)
destinations.nearestBusStation: Hampi Bazaar Bus Stand (0.2 km) / Hospet KSRTC (12 km)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Excellent 4-lane connectivity from Bengaluru and Hubballi
destinations.safetyInstructions: Hydrate continuously. Electric battery vehicles available between parking and Vittala Temple. Respect ASI boundary fences.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Single composite ASI ticket covers Vittala Temple & Zanana Enclosure
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Archaeological Survey of India & UNESCO World Heritage Centre

destinations.name: Tungabhadra Dam & Japanese Gardens
destinations.description: One of Karnataka's largest multipurpose masonry dams spanning the mighty Tungabhadra River, surrounded by the Vaikuntha hilltop viewpoint, musical dancing fountains, lush Japanese gardens, and deer park.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Inaugurated in 1953 as a premier post-independence engineering project designed by legendary engineer Dr. Thirumalai Iyengar.
destinations.culturalImportance: Vital lifeline irrigating millions of acres across Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh; major evening leisure destination with illuminated fountains.
destinations.bestSeason: August to February (Full reservoir flow and pleasant evenings)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Broad 4-lane city access road with ample parking
destinations.safetyInstructions: Follow posted security guidelines near dam crest. Musical fountain show starts at 19:00.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Tungabhadra Board ticket at garden entrance

destinations.name: Sanapur Lake & Boulder Canyon
destinations.description: A serene emerald-water reservoir fed by the Tungabhadra canal, framed by colossal ochre granite rock formations. Renowned for tranquil coracle rides, cliff sunsets, and pristine boulder landscapes.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Part of the ancient Kishkindha geological formations estimated at over 2.5 billion years old (Dharwar Craton).
destinations.culturalImportance: A beloved haven for nature photographers, international backpackers, and cliff-side tranquility seekers.
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 8 km from Hampi via coracle/bridge, 18 km from Hospet
destinations.roadAccessibility: Paved rural road winding through paddy fields and boulder passes
destinations.safetyInstructions: Swimming is strictly prohibited due to submerged rocks and sudden canal currents. Use authorized coracle boatmen with life jackets.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Open natural water body; coracle rides pay per ride
